source_backed: Important information should appear in at least two places as redundancy against stalls.
Dynamic or extra clues may be delivered when investigation progress stalls.
Mysteries may contain red herrings, false evidence, unreliable witnesses and corrupted information.
Mystery authoring separates surface clues, hidden connections and revealed or core truth.
Player-facing case material and GM solution material remain separate projections.

rules: A required revelation is an author-declared case objective dependency, not an automatically inferred truth.
Optional and bonus revelations may enrich or simplify a case but are not required for the authored minimum resolution path.
Dependencies must be explicit and versioned; spatial board proximity never creates a dependency.
Hidden or unauthorized nodes may participate in GM authoring diagnostics but are excluded from unauthorized Player diagnostics and projections.
A route is not considered available to an audience when an author-declared prerequisite is impossible or permanently unauthorized for that audience.

deterministic_rules: Start from author-declared entry routes whose prerequisites are satisfied in the diagnostic authoring model.
Traverse only explicit revelation dependencies and typed delivery routes.
Mark each required revelation reachable when at least one complete explicit route exists from an entry route under the selected audience scope.
Report but do not auto-correct unreachable required revelations.
Report circular dependencies that have no external entry route.
Report a single-point warning when a required revelation has exactly one surviving authored route.
Never infer a route from semantic similarity, graph proximity, AI suggestion or unstated GM intent.
The diagnostic is authoring evidence only and never resolves the Investigation or determines Player success.

redundancy_contract.source_guidance: Important information should appear in at least two places.
governed_interpretation: Authors may mark revelations as important_for_progression.
For an important_for_progression revelation, the diagnostic counts distinct explicit routes after collapsing duplicate-of routes.
Fewer than two distinct routes produces an authoring warning, not an automatic invalidation of every mystery.
Two or more routes satisfies the source-grounded redundancy warning condition but does not guarantee narrative quality, balance or Player success.
No rule converts the source guidance into a universal minimum number of clues across the whole Investigation.

rules: Stall recovery is attributable and does not silently alter prior clues or truth.
A recovery route may unlock a required revelation or another route but must remain explicit in diagnostics.
Dynamic delivery must preserve why it occurred so later review can distinguish authored baseline content from adaptive recovery.
Recovery never bypasses permissions or owning Action, Ability, Scene, Campaign or Setting rules.
False or misleading material remains visible according to reveal policy and does not mutate objective truth.
Diagnostics report when misleading material is the sole explicit route to a required revelation or when no authored correction or recovery path exists.
A diagnostic finding is not a universal fairness verdict and does not forbid a deliberate hard mystery.
Authors may accept a warning only through an attributable authoring decision; the warning itself does not rewrite content.
Annotations may use text or an explicitly adopted Campaign/rules vocabulary; PPIA-09 defines no mandatory universal numeric scale.
Unset and unknown are valid states.
Confidence is confidence in an assessment or theory, not objective truth probability.
Relevance describes authored investigative usefulness or relationship, not truth.
Authenticity concerns whether an object, source or record is genuine, altered or forged; it is independent of whether its contents are true.
Source reliability concerns an attributable source assessment and remains independent of witness belief and statement truth.
Contradiction records are explicit authoring relationships; the system does not infer a truth winner.
Timeline or alibi comparison may produce a contradiction finding only from explicit temporal records and declared incompatibility rules.
Resolved contradiction history retains both prior inputs and the authorized explanation or conclusion reference.
A contradiction hidden from an audience cannot leak through counts, badges, search, diagnostics or AI context.

acceptance_rules: Every required revelation can be checked for explicit reachability without inspecting unauthorized Player-hidden content in Player-facing diagnostics.
Important-information redundancy warnings use distinct explicit routes and preserve the source's at-least-two guidance without creating a universal clue count.
Circular and blocked dependencies are reported deterministically and never auto-repaired.
False-lead and corrupted-evidence diagnostics preserve attribution and do not adjudicate truth.
Uncertainty annotations never become objective truth probability by default.
Dynamic stall-recovery routes retain author, reason, source, audience and version evidence.
All diagnostic outputs are read-only authoring findings and cannot mutate truth, reveal state, conclusions or owning-domain objects.
